description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions on Alibaba QwQ 32B, step-by-step reasoning for math and logic. Set your OpenAI SDK base URL to https://agents.citiviewgroup.com/v1/qwq and pay per token with x402 instead of an API key: $1.32 per million input and $2 per million output tokens, minimum $0.002 a call, at most $0.0335. The 402 quotes your request's maximum; "upto" payers are charged only the tokens used. Same request/response shape as OpenAI (reasoning, streaming supported), up to 8192 output tokens. Costs $0.0335 USDC per call (x402).
